description: Function arity refuses with live's two sentences (codes 938/939): 'not enough arguments for function [F(...)], expected N, got M' - comma after the bracket - and 'too many arguments for function [F(...)] expected N, got M' - no comma; booleans render UPPER in the brackets, the refusal fires at compile time (an empty input still refuses) anchored on the call, FROM-less calls refuse the same sentences, an aggregate refuses an EMPTY argument list while multi-argument aggregate calls stay legal (COUNT(a, b) is accepted), and the rank family of window functions takes no arguments. Converted 1:1 from features/FunctionArityTest (now retired).
